title: Quick Start Guide
snippet: Quick Start Guide In this section we’ll get Gibson installed, started, and reachable from the tools you are likely to use during a mainframe security lab. The goal is not to teach every subsystem yet. The goal is to get you to a working console, prove the ports are listening, and understand what each window is showing you before you move into the deeper labs.
